source_tier: primary regulatory (DESFA capacity-reservation form) + trade press corroboration
source_notes: DESFA Technical Data Form for the ARGO FSRU (dated 10-04-2025) gives 'Desired Starting Date of Transmission Services: 01-07-2027' for the Volos entry point at an annual supply of 4.6 BCM (max 5.2 BCM for a limited period). PortsEurope (May 2025) independently reports Mediterranean Gas now targets July 2027 commercial operation. GEM currently shows LatestPlannedStartYear=2025 (= OriginalPlannedStartYear), which has slipped. This is a planned-start-year value edit, not a status change (status stays proposed).
scope_note: Single-unit terminal; project-level field. Capacity NOT changed: DESFA confirms 4.6 BCM baseload (GEM's 4.6 bcm / 3.38 mtpa is correct); the trade-press '5.2 bcm' is the limited-period maximum, not nameplate.

source_notes: HELLENiQ ENERGY completed the acquisition of the remaining 50% of Elpedison B.V. on 2025-07-15 (regulatory announcement), becoming sole (100%) shareholder; Edison (EDF group) sold its 50% for EUR 164m (+EUR 19m for cash reserves) and did not submit a counter-offer, ending the 15-year JV. Elpedison itself still owns the Thessaloniki FSRU 100% (Owner field unchanged); only the PARENT changes from the EDF/Hellenic Petroleum 50/50 JV to HELLENiQ at 100%. GEM's Thessaloniki row was LastUpdated 2025-07-16 (one day after completion) but the parent split was not updated.
scope_note: Single-unit terminal; project-level field. No dedicated 'Parent [ref]' column in GEM schema, so the parent source is recorded against Owner [ref] (Owner/Parent are paired). NOTE the GEM Entity ID for the new parent is ambiguous between two existing IDs and is flagged in qa, not guessed here.

source_notes: Athens Times (2025-08-05) reports Elpedison now targets commercial operation by January 2029, with environmental licensing expected by April 2026 followed by market testing. GEM currently shows LatestPlannedStartYear=2025 (= OriginalPlannedStartYear), now slipped. Single non-primary source -> yellow; recommend confirmation against Elpedison/HELLENiQ IR before applying. Planned-start-year value edit, not a status change.
scope_note: Single-unit terminal; project-level field. Capacity unchanged (7.3 bcm/y / 5.37 mtpa). Same article notes a second FSRU/FSU + FSU scope addition approved by RAAEY -> flagged in qa, not staged as a field here.
